title: SensorPush Dome Climate Weekly Out-of-Range Time Trend
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensorpush:climate out_of_range_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(out_of_range_minutes) as avg_duration, max(out_of_range_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst out-of-range time for SensorPush dome climate events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture out_of_range_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average out-of-range time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether SensorPush dome climate tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
